scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix shell && npm install --prefix mfe-usuario && npm install --prefix mfe-carona && npm install --prefix mfe-apartment && npm install --prefix mfe-chat
scripts.build:remotes: npm run build --prefix mfe-usuario && npm run build --prefix mfe-carona && npm run build --prefix mfe-apartment && npm run build --prefix mfe-chat
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix shell && npm run test --prefix mfe-usuario && npm run test --prefix mfe-carona && npm run test --prefix mfe-apartment && npm run test --prefix mfe-chat
scripts.start: concurrently -n "MFE-Usuario,MFE-Carona,MFE-Apartment,MFE-Chat,Shell" -c "blue,magenta,yellow,cyan,green" "npm run preview --prefix mfe-usuario" "npm run preview --prefix mfe-carona" "npm run preview --prefix mfe-apartment" "npm run preview --prefix mfe-chat" "npm run dev --prefix shell"
